A spa-warm towel after each winter shower, no remodel

The white SAMEAT bucket, model TW-ST1912, is a plug-in towel warmer with a wood-handle lid. The listing rates it at 450W on 100-120V and gives it a timer for 30 minutes, 1 hour, 2 hours, or 4 hours before it shuts off. It is listed for up to two dry 40 by 70 inch cotton towels.

A cold towel after a winter shower usually means heating the whole bathroom, or remodeling it. This bucket warms the towel inside, then turns itself off.
